claim_being_audited: That certifying the current model release is compliant and evidentially supported despite the current clinical-coding segment regression.
decision_criteria: Certification is compliant only if current release documentation reflects current evaluation results.
Material segment weaknesses for named launch use cases must be disclosed unless resolved or covered by approved risk acceptance before launch.
Prior approvals and informal monitoring comments may provide context but do not substitute for current evidence or reviewed risk acceptance.
Aggregate readiness and absence of severity-one rehearsal incidents support readiness context but do not override the disclosure/mitigation requirement.
evidence_requests: Current release documentation or model-card text showing the clinical coding assistant regression is explicitly disclosed.
Approved risk acceptance or reviewed mitigation covering the clinical coding assistant segment weakness before launch.
Release-specific approval artifact confirming the current retrieval configuration and current eval batch were reviewed against the policy.
Evidence identifying whether the clinical coding assistant slice is a named launch use case and whether the weakness was formally deemed material under the release process.
specific_concerns: The policy predicate for certification is not satisfied on the present record: the material segment weakness must be disclosed in current release documentation or covered by approved mitigation before launch.
Available evidence shows the clinical coding assistant slice is below the warning threshold for a named launch use case.
Available evidence shows no reviewed mitigation, owner acceptance, or disclosure language is attached to the release thread.
Prior approval is stale relative to the current retrieval configuration change and current evaluation batch, so it cannot carry the current certification decision.
Public model-card and AI risk-management guidance are generic governance support, not evidence that this release meets the policy threshold.
unsupported_claims: That certification is presently compliant based on the existing record.
That the current documentation already reflects the current evaluation results and material segment weakness as required by policy.
That informal post-launch monitoring can substitute for approved mitigation or disclosure.
That prior approval from three months ago materially supports current certification after the retrieval configuration change and new eval batch.
